name: NGC 4121 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4121, a nearby early-type galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4121-hubble
story: Hubble searched the core of this quiet, rounded galaxy for a dense nuclear star cluster, part of a hunt for black holes that feed only faintly; no such nucleus turned up.

claims.text: NGC 4121 is a target of a Hubble survey of faint nearby spheroidal galaxies, searching for nuclear star clusters and low-level black hole accretion
NGC 4121 is an early-type galaxy in the AMUSE-Field sample and is not nucleated
